newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Plessey sells consumer product interests.
newsitem.headline: Plessey sells consumer product interests.

text.p: South Africa's electronics group Plessey Corp Ltd said on Monday it was selling its remaining interests in its consumer products operation to Omega Holdings Ltd for an undisclosed sum.
The company said in a statement that its consumer products operations housed the marketing and distribution arms for Telefunken and Pioneer Tv and audio products in South Africa
The conclusion of the deal would take a few weeks due to fulfilment of technical issues, which meant a final announcement would only be made in due course.
Until then, the company said shareholders should exercise caution in their sharedealings.
